generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Improves prompts, rules, and rubrics. Validate with holdout tasks, A/B tests, and regression checks.

contract.purpose_user_function: Optimize text-based prompts/rules/rubrics as versioned candidates, evaluate them, and promote only passing candidates.
contract.valid_inputs: Source text artifact, task/golden/holdout cases, budget, candidate generator/backend, hard policies, evaluation metrics, and active version.
contract.expected_outputs: Candidate artifacts, evaluation comparison, budget/policy findings, promotion decision, and rollback-capable stored version.
contract.state_side_effects: Writes candidate/evaluation artifacts and, on approved promotion, updates the promoted artifact pointer/version.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Budget/policy violation, invalid candidate, holdout regression, evaluation failure, or promotion conflict leaves current artifact active.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: GEPA integration is shipped. MIPROv2 and TextGrad implementations were not found in current codebase.
contract.success_evidence: Versioned GEPA candidate and evaluation artifacts satisfy hard policies and promotion tests under harness/tests/integrations/gepa_optimizer/.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: candidate schema; budget boundary; hard-policy rejection; holdout improvement/regression; promote; rollback/no-change.
contract.cli_api_skill_interfaces: harness/lib/evolution_engine.py: scorecard(), promote(), demote_degraded(), recommend(), run_loop(); harness/tools/skill_evolution_runner.py: run_once(); core/nerve/evolution-engine.ts: EvolutionEngine
contract.implementation_entrypoints: harness/integrations/gepa_optimizer/adapter.py, evaluator.py, hard_policy_checker.py, promote.py, cli.py; MIPROv2/TextGrad: Not found in current codebase
contract.platform_provider_limitations: Generic evidence, scorecard, evaluation-pack, promotion, and rollback controls are local; named optimization/training algorithms may need optional integrations, datasets, model providers, accelerators, or are absent.

implementation.entrypoints: harness/integrations/gepa_optimizer/adapter.py, evaluator.py, hard_policy_checker.py, promote.py, cli.py; MIPROv2/TextGrad: Not found in current codebase
implementation.interfaces: harness/lib/evolution_engine.py: scorecard(), promote(), demote_degraded(), recommend(), run_loop(); harness/tools/skill_evolution_runner.py: run_once(); core/nerve/evolution-engine.ts: EvolutionEngine
